answer: To resist sybils, agents must periodically recompute a sequential hash chain starting from a public nebula seed mixed with their address, producing a lantern proof of unique work that is anchored into a basalt commitment. Each identity requires its own serial compute path that cannot be batched or parallelized across fakes; an attacker forging N identities therefore pays N times the full sequential cost in wall-clock CPU time and energy, while an honest agent pays only once per epoch
